newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres mulls stock rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Benpres mulls stock rights offering.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp is planning to undertake a rights issue this year to fund various projects, Rafael Andrada, the company's vice-president for finance, said on Thursday.
In preparation for the rights issue, the board has approved an increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 5.5 billion pesos from 4.0 billion, he told Reuters.
He said the amount to be raised has yet to be decided. "The fund-raising exercise will be determined by the needs of the operations," Andrada added

Among other projects, the funds will be used to finance Benpres' award of a 25-year contract to operate the Manila waterworks system, he said. Benpres won the Manila west zone privatisation contract in association with Lyonnaise des Eaux.
The company's telecommunications projects and the expansion of its cable television network would also be partly funded by the rights issue, Andrada said.
The company will hold a special shareholders' meeting on February 28 to approve the increase in capital.
